notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
description:
Cause any creature to enter the battlefield under your control, triggering Jaws of Defeat.
Holding priority, cast Overkill by paying {2}{B}, giving the creature that entered -0/-9999 until end of turn.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having less than 0 toughness.
Resolve the Jaws of Defeat trigger, causing target opponent to lose life equal to the difference between the creature's power and toughness, using its last known information.
